snippet.title: CARD MAKE ARENA | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3776020/Card_Make_Arena/

What card will YOU forge?

Card Make Arena is a card game where you create your own cards and battle with them.
You can freely customize not only effects, costs, and activation conditions, but also the name and illustration.
Craft your very own cards and aim for victory!

Currently in development, with an Early Access release on Steam planned within 2026.
Add it to your wishlist and stay tuned for further updates.
